items.question: Is Specialist Group a licensed recruitment agency?
items.answer: Yes. Specialist Group holds official government License No. 0078, issued by the Agency for External Labour Migration of the Republic of Uzbekistan. Our register number, TIN and registration number are published openly on our License & Compliance page.

items.question: Which countries do you deploy workers to?
items.answer: We currently place workers across 18 destination countries, including South Korea, Germany, Japan, Poland, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and the United Kingdom, under bilateral agreements and direct employer partnerships.

items.question: How long does the recruitment process take?
items.answer: Timelines depend on role, country and documentation, but a typical placement runs from 6 to 12 weeks — from your initial request to worker arrival. We provide a precise timeline with every proposal.

items.question: Are the workers pre-screened and trained?
items.answer: Every candidate undergoes skills assessment, medical examination and background verification. Where required, workers complete vocational and language training before deployment so they are productive from day one.

items.question: Do workers pay recruitment fees?
items.answer: No. In line with international fair-recruitment principles, we do not charge recruitment fees to workers. Our service is contracted with and paid for by the employer.

items.question: Can we interview candidates before selection?
items.answer: Absolutely. You can interview shortlisted candidates in person in Uzbekistan or remotely via video. You make the final selection — we simply present qualified, verified candidates.

items.question: What industries do you cover?
items.answer: Construction, industrial and manufacturing, agriculture, food production, hospitality, healthcare (nurses and caregivers), textile, skilled trades and other specialist roles.

items.question: How do we get started?
items.answer: Submit a workforce request through our website or contact our team directly. You will receive a tracking number and a tailored proposal within one business day.
